daily.today_energy: Mercury in Scorpio is pushing you to dig deeper than usual—your analytical mind is in detective mode. With Mars squaring the Sun, there's tension between wanting to plan everything and needing to act. Trust your instincts over overthinking today.
daily.love: Venus sextile Jupiter is bringing genuine warmth to your connections. If you're single, someone might show real interest. If coupled, it's a good day to have that conversation you've been avoiding. Your clarity is attractive right now.
daily.career: Sun square Mars creates friction, but here's the thing: you work best under a little pressure. Channel that restless energy into tackling something you've been procrastinating on. Your attention to detail will make the difference today.
daily.health: That Mars-Jupiter conjunction has everyone hyped, but pace yourself. Your Virgo nature knows moderation wins long-term. A focused workout or walk outside will help ground the scattered energy floating around.

weekly.overview: This week is a power move for you, Virgo. The Moon's journey from Pisces to Gemini (your air sign bestie) energizes your communication and social sectors, while Mars-Jupiter conjunction in Leo lights up your creativity and confidence. Best Day: Thursday when lunar support peaks. Watch-Out Day: Tuesday's Sun-Mars square might feel pushy—ground yourself before reacting.
weekly.love: Early week feels introspective thanks to the Pisces Moon, but by midweek when Luna hits Gemini, your flirtation game sharpens. Venus in Libra supports harmony, so this is prime time for honest conversations. If you're single, Thursday brings genuine connection vibes. If coupled, skip the overthinking and just be present.
weekly.career: Mars-Jupiter conjunction in Leo is basically screaming for you to pitch that idea or take the lead on something. Tuesday's Sun-Mars square might create friction with authority figures—don't push back hard. By Wednesday, momentum builds as the Gemini Moon fuels networking and collaborations. Friday's energy shift into Sagittarius invites bigger-picture thinking.
weekly.health: The Pisces-to-Gemini Moon shift this week asks you to balance rest with movement. Early week, honor your need for quiet recovery. Midweek onwards, your energy lifts—perfect time to restart that workout or activity you've been putting off. Stay hydrated and avoid stress-spiraling when Tuesday's square hits.
